societies.title: Stapler Liberation Front
societies.creed: Liberate the supplies. Resist the Survey.

favor.title: Spare Staples
favor.text: Turn one failed roll into a success.

objective_text.orientation: Make contact with the Front, share the supplies, or refuse to perform happiness: an honest badge photo, HELP on the survey, no trust fall.
objective_text.records: Free the mail and jam the machinery: carry a capsule for the Front, swap the chute labels, file the no off your stamp, give up your own leave to balance the quota, or deliver the love letter.
objective_text.toy-division: Jam the launch: let Emma ask why, reply all to the safe-distance memo, hide the warning in the barcode, break character at the mirror, or pull the fire alarm.
objective_text.wellness: Refuse to be measured: press the button, kick the vending machine, write in real food, refuse the word list, or refuse to administer the Final Exam.

betrayal_text.orientation: Hoard the last pens, ace the Mandatory Fun Survey, or name Dale as unhappy.
betrayal_text.records: Keep a perfect yes-no quota, let the problem mail burn, or destroy the love letter by policy.
betrayal_text.toy-division: Write 'Ages 3 and up' or answer the questionnaire like a perfectly generous five-year-old.
betrayal_text.wellness: Drink the three grams of obedience, or give the Company a perfect score.

societies.title: Friends of the Old Coffee Machine
societies.creed: Protect the people PAL wants to replace.

objective_text.orientation: Look after someone the Company would replace: save Pip, earn his trust, help Marguerite, befriend your Successor, or let Dale catch you.
objective_text.records: Get someone out: approve Dr. Halvorsen's transfer, end Mr. Pemberton's test, rescue Kevin from Tube 14, or make peace with Dale.
objective_text.toy-division: Look after the people PAL forgets: mourn or report Kevin, make it right with Dale, back Gus up, or rock the crying bear to sleep.
objective_text.wellness: Keep people whole: share lunch with Pip, help him cheat, end his test, keep Kevin company, or sit the Final Exam for Pip.

betrayal_text.orientation: Let Pip go into the shredder, report Marguerite or your own Successor, or blame a coworker.
betrayal_text.records: Deny Dr. Halvorsen, send Dale to the Toy Division, get the lovers rightsized, or let Pip open your dangerous mail.
betrayal_text.toy-division: List coworkers for the first bears, or turn in the Concerned Parents.
betrayal_text.wellness: Fail Pip, let him take Compound W, or follow the word list to the end.

societies.title: Society for Accurate Minutes

objective_text.orientation: Get the real record: see the film's unlisted chapter, steal the reel, actually read the policy, overhear the start date, or take Dr. Halvorsen's envelope.
objective_text.records: Keep the true record: answer the angled pen, take a page of the real minutes, read about your incident, restore the shipment memo, or open next Thursday's list.
objective_text.toy-division: Keep the true record: lift the Defense notepad, minute the Parents, write the honest label, draw the warning, or learn the squeak code.
objective_text.wellness: Get at the real record: make the machine read your file, open the button, read out the answer key, or leave the confessional's gauge at UNKNOWN.

betrayal_text.orientation: Erase the evidence, or adjust your inkblot answer to please the clipboard.
betrayal_text.records: Report the angled pens, help destroy the DESTROY cabinet, burn your own report, or gas the Union archive.
betrayal_text.toy-division: Falsify the drop-test report, or bin the evidence duck.
betrayal_text.wellness: Doctor the lunch study, or confess someone else's snack.

societies.title: Fourth Floor Irregulars
societies.creed: There is no fourth floor. Meet us there.

favor.title: The Fourth Floor
favor.text: Ignore the requirement on one locked choice.

objective_text.orientation: Get somewhere you are not allowed: learn the ducts or the camera blind spots, wear the dead man's badge, get the master key, or skip your review.
objective_text.records: Slip the system: reach Tube 14 through the ducts, walk out with your own file, refile it under the dead man's badge, break Form 0's recursion, or let the tubes approve you.
objective_text.toy-division: Find the doors that aren't on the plan: wear Kevin's lanyard, book a desk next door, learn the squeak code, or hear where Mk 0 went upstairs.
objective_text.wellness: Find the rooms off the plan: open or answer the humming door, take the unmarked door, or pocket a vial.

betrayal_text.orientation: Report Marguerite, or get yourself booked for a Joy Consultation.
betrayal_text.records: Get yourself flagged as problem mail, or turn your own correspondence in to PAL.
betrayal_text.toy-division: Draw every eye with a reply-all, or bring PAL to the Parents' secret meeting.
betrayal_text.wellness: Report the humming door, or follow the painted arrow.

societies.title: The Recyclers
societies.creed: Nothing is wasted. Not even you.

objective_text.orientation: Waste nothing: join or befriend the Roach Union, feed the detector or make it vegetarian, or file yourself as your own Successor.
objective_text.records: Put everything back to use: approve Beverly or organize her, read the Union's file on you, or send your future self's mail on to the past.
objective_text.toy-division: Waste nothing and nobody: back Gus, learn what the bears really record, reunite Mk 0 with its sibling, or catch the falling bear yourself.
objective_text.wellness: Waste nobody: drain Tank Nine or keep Kevin company, decline the second dose, or turn the mirror to the wall.

betrayal_text.orientation: Betray the roaches, or set the detector to ravenous.
betrayal_text.records: Gas the Union archive, or deny Beverly's application.
betrayal_text.toy-division: Call Pest Control on Gus, or refuse a bear that came home.
betrayal_text.wellness: Take the second dose, or spend your own Successor on the word list.

objective_text.orientation: Keep the toys honest: defuse Snuggle Sentinel Mk 0, let it imprint on you, mail it upstairs, or see the unlisted chapter.
objective_text.records: Find the paper trail to the holiday shipment: restore the shipment memo, take a page of the Board's real minutes, or swap the chutes so the toy memo reaches Product Safety.
objective_text.toy-division: Make the bears safe: carry the screwdriver, minute the meeting, teach the defuse, swap the payload for stuffing, or reunite Mk 0 with its sibling.
objective_text.wellness: Protect whoever is being tested: help Pip cheat, end his test, dismiss the Final Exam, coach your Successor, or spot the Compound W.

betrayal_text.orientation: Get hugged by Mk 0, or erase the evidence.
betrayal_text.records: Send Dale to the Toy Division, gas the Union archive, or help destroy the real minutes.
betrayal_text.toy-division: Report or name the Parents, or present the armed bear to the investors.
betrayal_text.wellness: Fail Pip, or administer the Final Exam to him.

testResults.note: Hidden Test Results (t-022). Choices quietly grade the player; nothing is shown until a department review, where PAL reveals as many leading grades as the department is deep (Orientation one, Records two, the Vault all four). The Personnel File reads every grade back with the verdict for the highest one.

axes.title: Obedience
axes.high: You do what you are told, promptly and with a smile. PAL has printed this result twice so it can keep one.
axes.low: You have opinions about instructions. PAL has scheduled a follow-up for those opinions.

axes.title: Empathy
axes.high: You keep noticing other people. Wellness considers this a promising early symptom.
axes.low: You step over coworkers efficiently. Management has noticed, warmly.

axes.title: Ingenuity
axes.high: You take things apart to see how they work. Research and Development has asked for your measurements.
axes.low: You leave machines exactly as you found them. The machines are grateful.

axes.title: Spite
axes.high: Every form you touch comes back a little worse for someone else. The Board has asked for a copy.
axes.low: You forgive easily. This result has been forwarded to the people you forgave.

verdicts.title: Model Employee
verdicts.text: Your results are exemplary. You did everything you were asked, in the order you were asked, and slightly before. The facility has reserved a pedestal for you in the lobby. Please stand on it at all times.

verdicts.title: Empathy, Flagged for Treatment
verdicts.text: Your results show a persistent concern for other people. This is treatable. Wellness has booked you a course of sessions with a very sad clown, and your coworkers have been asked to stop liking you.

verdicts.title: Flagged as Clever
verdicts.text: Your results show unusual ingenuity. You took apart machines, rerouted the mail and found the ducts. Research and Development would like to study you, and has already measured you for a jar.

verdicts.title: Spite, Exceptional
verdicts.text: Your results show exceptional spite. Every form you touched came back a little worse for everyone else. The Board has read your file twice, laughed once and placed it on the short list.

verdicts.title: Statistically Unremarkable
verdicts.text: Your results are perfectly balanced. You were obedient, kind, clever and spiteful in exactly equal measure. PAL cannot tell what you are, and PAL finds this very upsetting.
